notes: Checked DOI 10.3389/fmicb.2021.643498 (PMID 33776977, PMC7991086, Li et al. 2021 Front Microbiol). Quote verbatim in full text Results: "Taken together, we have demonstrated that EvpQ is a T6SS effector that is translocated into eukaryotic host cells." Documents T6SS-dependent secretion (anti-HA immunoblot of culture supernatant, EvpO/EvpC controls) + translocation into EPC host cells (mechanic fractionation). Strain nuance: paper studies E. piscicida PPD130/91; row lists EIB202. Full text states ETAE_2037 of E. piscicida EIB202 = EvpQ (same gene/protein, different strain of same species) -> strain_diff, conserved.

Checked DOI 10.1073/pnas.1608858113 (PMID 27503894, PMC5003274, Sana et al. 2016 PNAS). Quote verbatim in abstract: "...this activity is mediated by the specific interaction of Hcp1 with the antibacterial amidase Tae4". Organism matches S. Typhimurium (SPI-6 T6SS, 14028 lineage). PMC full text body empty; verified from abstract. Secretion evidence is delivery/interaction-based: Tae4 loaded/delivered via Hcp1 nanotube subunit and Hcp1-dependent T6SS killing of K. oxytoca; not direct supernatant blot of Tae4 in this paper, but machinery-dependent delivery shown. confidence medium.

Checked DOI 10.1111/mmi.13292 (PMID 26714038, Flaugnatti et al. 2016 Mol Microbiol). Quote verbatim in abstract: "We further identify Tle1, a toxin effector encoded by this cluster and showed that Tle1 possesses phospholipase A1 and A2 activities required for the interbacterial competition." Documents secretion: Tle1 is a T6SS effector delivered into prey periplasm via the VgrG1 spike (Sci-1 T6SS of entero-aggregative E. coli). Organism match: EAEC 042 is the standard entero-aggregative E. coli / Sci-1 strain (abstract says "entero-aggregative Escherichia coli Sci-1 T6SS"; body uses 042).
